instagram.caption:
How a softball team can get closer to a tournament trip with one Thanksgiving board. Swipe through the math.

Squares at $10. 100 squares on the board. That's $1,000, with $500 to the winner and $500 to the team, for example. Run two games and the trip is a lot closer.

The board is free. Each team collects and pays out on its own. We never touch the money. Link in bio.

Save this for your next booster meeting.
